mumu_adb_description: Maa native Android capture and touch. Requires Limbus already in the foreground; does not launch the game.
description: Native Windows Limbus automation with MaaFramework
mirror_status: Development: entry navigation only; five floors and team rotation are not verified.
team_library_scope: Select and verify a team on the Sinners team-management page. Does not enter a dungeon.
theme_pack_scope: Current Hard pack page only. Save one preference for this team and drag the best identified pack. Stops with a fresh frame; map transition not yet verified.
deployment_scope: Current battle preparation only. Uses saved order, verifies count and order after each choice, then stops before starting battle. Experimental; live geometry unverified.
battle_plan_scope: Experimental English battle page only. Press P once through Maa, retain a fresh frame and stop. Does not submit a turn or verify victory.
windows_window_description: MaaEnd-style background capture, cursor-position window mouse messages and PostMessage keys. Verify the expected next page after input.
windows_background_description: Window-position mouse messages and PostMessage keys. Test whether this game accepts background input.
windows_front_description: Screen capture and foreground mouse/keyboard input. Keep the game visible.
mirror_loop_scope: Play a whole run with the team the rotation points at: entry, five floors, rewards, re-entry. The keywords chosen below are written into the team and saved as a team build first.
team_build_scope: Write the keywords into the team and save it as a team build, without starting a run.
team_keywords_description: The team keywords the formation and the gift plan use; Charge + Tremor by default.
team_keywords_extra_description: Extra keywords, comma separated, e.g. Charge,Tremor.
team_build_name_description: The name this formation is saved under; blank keeps the team's current name.
run_team_description: Which team this run uses; the rotation ledger wins when it points at a team.
team_build_slot_description: Which saved team this build is written to; 1..20, the same numbering the rotation uses.
global_build_description: Save systems and all twelve deployment positions globally. Keep saved leaves imported builds intact. Edits are validated and saved before the next Mirror task.
software_auto_update_description: The desktop launcher checks official stable releases before opening the app, preserves settings and rolls back failed installs. Offline or rate-limited checks use the local version. Applies on next launch.
main_open_game_description: Launch Android through Maa and verify the foreground; leave an already open game running. Connect the game window first on Windows.
main_mirror_description: Use global saved builds and deployment order. Choose one team or a rotation here. Hard by default; spending requires a configured budget.
main_experience_description: Uses a saved team. Stage and cost recognition are under development; currently captures evidence and stops.
main_thread_description: Uses a saved team. Stage and cost recognition are under development; currently captures evidence and stops.
main_rewards_description: Mail and daily reward recognition are under development; currently captures evidence and stops. Mirror rewards stay in the Mirror task.
main_stamina_description: Budgeted conversion recognition is under development; currently captures evidence and stops without spending.
mirror_star_description: Lix zero-based 0–9: left to right, upper row then lower. Base graces only, no Enhance or remaining-star conversion. Auto mode takes an affordable subset of the saved build plan (task choices if absent), with current visible prices and the per-run budget. Unknown prices or pending transactions stop.
mirror_initial_keyword_description: Selects the initial gift group. Floor gifts still use the saved build systems and preferences.
mirror_gift_search_description: Only refusing search is supported; this setting never authorizes payment.
mirror_run_bounds_description: Bounded steps per launch, not dungeon runs. Reaching the limit preserves state and stops.
mirror_preferences_description: Edits add or remove only the selected preferences when the Mirror task starts. Systems, order and other entries are preserved. Active-build changes stop; blocks win.
